cycle1_ars_setup.description: Prepare deterministic Wizardry wand, scroll, Ars spell, resource controls, and zero-discipline baseline
commands: replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.0 ebwizardry:magic_wand 1 0 {spells:[I;1,0,0,0,0],selectedSpell:0,display:{Name:"IMP-013 Magic Missile Wand"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.2 ebwizardry:scroll 8 1 {display:{Name:"IMP-013 Magic Missile Scroll"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.3 minecraft:nether_star 1 0 {display:{Name:"IMP-013 Set JAWMS to 60"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.4 minecraft:redstone_torch 1 0 {display:{Name:"IMP-013 Set JAWMS to 0"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.5 ebwizardry:apprentice_ice_wand 1 0 {spells:[I;20,0,0,0,0],selectedSpell:0,display:{Name:"IMP-013 Ice Shard Potency Wand"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.6 arsmagica2:infinity_orb 1 0 {display:{Name:"IMP-013 One Blue Discipline Point"}}

cycle1_ars_full_jawms_ready.description: Record exact JAWMS 60 and Ars 0 after the owner uses the nether-star control

cycle1_ars_wand_observe.description: Record authoritative state after one Magic Missile wand cast

cycle1_ars_scroll_ready.description: Record exact JAWMS 60 and Ars 0 before the distinct Wizardry scroll branch

cycle1_ars_scroll_observe.description: Record state and scroll count after one Magic Missile scroll cast

cycle1_ars_inverse_ready.description: Record JAWMS 0 and full Ars after the owner uses the redstone-torch control

cycle1_ars_inverse_observe.description: Record the rejected Wizardry cast with JAWMS empty and Ars full

cycle1_ars_silence_ready.description: Apply native Ars silence before a funded Wizardry cast

cycle1_ars_silence_cleanup.description: Remove Ars silence after the owner confirms rejection

cycle1_ars_native_ready.description: Record full Ars resources and empty JAWMS before one Ars-native spell

cycle1_ars_native_observe.description: Record Ars-native mana and burnout changes without JAWMS mutation

cycle1_ars_potency_control_ready.description: Reset disciplines and prepare the zero-discipline Ice Shard damage control

cycle1_ars_potency_control_observe.description: Record the zero-discipline target after one Ice Shard wand cast

cycle1_ars_potency_disciplined_ready.description: Prepare an identical target after the owner allocates exactly one Ice discipline level

cycle1_ars_potency_observe.description: Record the one-Ice-discipline target after one Ice Shard wand cast

cycle1_ars_disabled_setup.description: Start the disabled-integration session with deterministic Wizardry fixtures and full Ars resources
commands: replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.0 ebwizardry:magic_wand 1 0 {spells:[I;1,0,0,0,0],selectedSpell:0,display:{Name:"IMP-013 Disabled Magic Missile Wand"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.3 minecraft:nether_star 1 0 {display:{Name:"IMP-013 Set JAWMS to 60"}}
replaceitem entity @s slot.hotbar.4 minecraft:redstone_torch 1 0 {display:{Name:"IMP-013 Set JAWMS to 0"}}

cycle1_ars_disabled_observe.description: Record restored native Ars Wizardry payment after one disabled-state cast

cycle1_ars_cleanup.description: Remove controlled fixtures and close the Ars payment campaign
